title: GenZ's Modpack
description: A simple and easy Fabric modpack inspired by GenZ's Minecraft setup. It is made to improve FPS, visuals, and overall gameplay experience while keeping the game clean, and simply fantastic.
body:
### **GenZ’s Modpack — First Official Release**

**GenZ’s Modpack** is a Fabric modpack built for smoother gameplay, better FPS, and a cleaner Minecraft experience while still staying close to vanilla.

It focuses on performance and small visual upgrades that make the game feel more polished without changing how Minecraft actually plays. Everything is kept simple so it works well for survival, SMPs, and just everyday gameplay.

## **Features**

* Better FPS and overall performance
* Smoother gameplay
* Clean visual improvements
* Improved UI and small quality-of-life changes
* Better animations and camera feel
* Shader support (Iris)
* Vanilla-friendly design

## **Recommended Shaders**

* Complementary Unbound

It’s made to feel like normal Minecraft, just more smooth, stable, and nice to play.
